page.layout: One printed page holding a table in columns: Anni Iul., Lit.dom., Nabonasari, Feriae, a centre column of "Iul." marks, and Christi at the right. Running head ANNORVM at the top, page number 405 at the top right, signature Cc iij at the foot right.

main_text.l: Anni Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabonasari. | Feriae. | Christi.

page.notes: The marks "b" before 864 and "c" before 880 are small printed signs in the Nabonasari column, copied as b864 and c880; they may be errata or reference marks and are not certain. The Iul. marks (28 to 21 Iul.) sit in a centre column between Feriae and Christi and belong to the row where they stand. The Christi numbers are set in old-style figures and are copied here as Arabic numerals.
